bib.title: Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs

question: Can one attention architecture with linear cost in input and output size handle arbitrary structured inputs and outputs (language, flow, multimodal, games) without task-specific design?
hypothesis: Adding a query-based attention decoder to the Perceiver lets it produce arbitrary-shaped outputs and serve as a general-purpose, domain-agnostic architecture.
contributions: Perceiver IO: encode inputs to a small latent array by cross-attention, process with latent self-attention, decode with output-specific query array
Tokenizer-free byte-level language model matching SentencePiece BERT on GLUE
State-of-the-art Sintel.final optical flow without cost volumes or warping
Multimodal video/audio/label autoencoding and multitask GLUE with one network

method.summary: Perceiver IO encodes an M x C input array to an N x D latent array via cross-attention, applies L latent self-attention modules, and decodes an O x E output by cross-attention from a query array built from position, task, modality or input features. All modules are GPT-2-style QKV attention plus MLP. Evaluated on MLM/GLUE, optical flow, Kinetics autoencoding, ImageNet, StarCraft II and AudioSet.
method.task: general structured-input/output prediction (MLM, optical flow, multimodal autoencoding, classification)

datasets.name: English Wikipedia + C4
datasets.split: 70% of training tokens from C4, 30% from Wikipedia; 10 documents concatenated before cropping
datasets.preprocessing: 15% of words masked independently (whitespace-delimited words); SentencePiece vocab 32,000 or UTF-8 bytes (256 + 4 special tokens)

datasets.name: GLUE
datasets.split: dev set, WNLI excluded; best over hyperparameter grid per task

datasets.name: AutoFlow
datasets.preprocessing: default AutoFlow augmentation curriculum plus a final no-augmentation phase with forward and reversed pairs

datasets.name: Sintel (clean, final) and KITTI
datasets.split: evaluated tiled, six evenly spaced tiles

datasets.name: Kinetics-700-2020
datasets.preprocessing: 16 frames 224x224, patches 1x4x4 video and 16 audio samples; audio 48kHz (1920 samples/frame); label masked 50% of time in training

models.name: Perceiver IO Base (SentencePiece)
models.architecture: encoder cross-attn, latent self-attn, decoder cross-attn

models.name: Perceiver IO ImageNet config A
models.architecture: 8 blocks of 6 attention modules, weights shared across blocks

models.name: Perceiver IO ImageNet config B (pretrained)
models.architecture: 16-layer latent network, no weight sharing, MLP hidden 4x

training.objective: MLM softmax cross-entropy (language); flow regression on AutoFlow; weighted L1(video)+L1(audio)+CE(label) for Kinetics; cross-entropy for ImageNet; multi-one-hot cross-entropy for JFT
training.lr: MLM 0.00125; GLUE sweep {1e-4,5e-5,2e-5,1e-5}; flow 4e-4; Kinetics 1e-3; ImageNet 2e-3 flat; JFT 3e-4
training.lr_schedule: MLM: linear warmup then cosine decay to 500,000 steps; flow: cosine from 4e-4; ImageNet: flat 55 epochs then cosine to 0 over last 55, no warmup; JFT cosine to 0 over 14 epochs
training.warmup: MLM 1,000 steps; GLUE 200 steps; ImageNet none
training.batch_size: MLM 2048; GLUE {16,32,64}; flow 512; Kinetics 1024; ImageNet 1024; JFT 8192
training.regularisation: ImageNet: CutMix ratio 0.2, MixUp, RandAugment, gradient clip global norm 10
training.hardware: ImageNet 64 TPUs; JFT 256 TPUs; framework JAX; TPUv3

other.ImageNet finetune from JFT: 131K steps, batch 1024, 64 TPUs, LAMB flat LR 0.002 for 70K steps then cosine for last 61K; conv variant base LR 0.0002 (0.002 unstable)
other.Kinetics decoding in training: subsample 512 audio samples and 512 pixels plus label per example
other.StarCraft II: 3-layer Perceiver IO, 32 latents (tried 32, 64), ImageNet hyperparameters, behavioral cloning
other.AudioSet: 12 processor modules, N=512 latents, D in {512,1024}, 32-frame clips train and 16 overlapping clips test

inference.decoding: parallel query decoding; at test time outputs generated in batches to cover full output array

other.flow eval: tiled with six tiles, overlaps averaged weighted by distance to tile edge

metrics.name: GLUE average
metrics.definition: Pearson on STS-B, Matthews on CoLA, accuracy elsewhere; MNLI-m and mm averaged as one task; WNLI excluded

metrics.name: EPE
metrics.definition: average end-point error for optical flow

metrics.name: PSNR
metrics.definition: reconstruction quality for audio and video

metrics.name: win rate
metrics.definition: StarCraft II vs Elite bot after behavioral cloning

eval.protocol: GLUE reports best dev score over a fixed hyperparameter grid per task; FLOPs counted with multiply and accumulate separate (fused would halve them); no seeds or variance reported

availability.data: JFT is internal; other datasets public

limits: Perceiver IO requires all input points to be encoded simultaneously; scaling to even larger inputs is future work (Sec I)
Multimodal reconstructions are blurry, partly due to coarse patching
Class accuracy and PSNR trade off through loss weights
No seeds, variance or significance tests reported
Image classification not extensively tuned for efficiency; ImageNet best result needs JFT pretraining on an internal dataset
Flow model cannot yet be shape-invariant; evaluation needs tiling
Optical flow slower than RAFT on GPU; failure cases on shadows and compression artifacts
Language: encoder-style MLM only, no autoregressive generation shown

terms.definition: array with as many elements as the desired output, each built from position, task, modality or input features, used to cross-attend into the latents

lineage.work: Perceiver: General perception with iterative attention
lineage.note: adds query-based decoder to Perceiver's encoder and latent transformer
Perceiver IO replaces its entity Transformer
